title: A ticket price
description:
Work out a ticket price from the age and the day.

```
Age? 15
Day (mon..sun)? TUE
Ticket: 4.50
```

starter.main.lua:
io.write("Age? ")
local age = tonumber(io.read())
io.write("Day (mon..sun)? ")
local day = io.read()
local price = 0
-- TODO
print(string.format("Ticket: %.2f", price))

hints: Check the ranges from the bottom up with `if`, `elseif` and `else` (lesson 1.05).
requirements: On Tuesday take 2.00 off, but never below 3.00. Accept the day in any case.
A negative age prints `Not a valid age`.
stretch: Read several tickets until an empty line and print the total.
